Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: PRODUCTION transparent sprite atlas for a top-down WW2 hex strategy game. Input image 1 is the EXACT atlas layout and geometry edit target, image 2 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY (the user's approved concept). Redraw image 1 to approach the rich hand-painted earthwork style of image 2. Preserve ALL 14 separate trench sprites at their EXACT coordinates and scale, a 4-column by 4-row invisible cell grid, last two cells empty; preserve the canvas aspect ratio 1080:1200. DO NOT rearrange, resize, add, duplicate or connect the separate sprites. Every trench arm must end at the exact existing location with its existing width and orientation. Centerlines and connectivity invariant. Transparent background, no grass, no hex grid or tile backgrounds, no text, no borders.
Replace thin smooth brown outlines and photographic dirt noise with lovingly illustrated sculpted earth walls: chunky irregular tan and ochre dirt clods with a bold dark-brown inner cut edge, actual visible layered inner earth wall, deep narrow contact shadow beneath the lip and a flatter legible dark warm brown trench floor. Larger sparse angular stones on floor, no tiny gravel noise. Strong graphic small-scale readability. Show earth volumes with warm upper-left highlights and deep brown crevices, restrained outlines. Entirely strict overhead orthographic view, NO isometric perspective. Keep floor passage space intact, wall masses along the rim only. Enlarge wooden duckboard panels to clear groups of 4 or 5 thick weathered planks on some arms, preserve original general locations but no wood on cut edge ends. A few larger olive-khaki canvas sandbags on walls near intersections/closed ends, NOT continuous sandbag rings. All features painted together as whole objects (not a flat texture). Draw ONLY the 14 trenches, no units, guns, crates, particles, interface. Real alpha transparency. Output target 2160x2400 if possible, preserving identical composition.

Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: PRODUCTION transparent sprite atlas for a top-down WW2 hex strategy game. Image 1 is the EXACT layout / geometry edit target (14 EMPTY antitank gun pits), image 2 is the user's desired hand-painted art style reference ONLY. Redraw image 1 in the rich illustrated style of image 2. Preserve ALL 14 separate sprites at their EXACT positions, size, connectivity, on the same invisible 4-column by 4-row grid, last two cells EMPTY. Preserve aspect ratio 1080:1200 and original centers. Every narrow connecting trench arm must reach its exact original end location and width. Do not rearrange or connect sprites.
Each pit has a broad approximately round open unobstructed dark warm brown earthen gun platform, surrounded by a thick uneven sculpted low earth parapet. Give the rim large individually painted chunky tan and ochre dirt clods, layered inner cut-earth wall, strong dark contact shadows UNDER the earth lip, soft warm highlights atop earth blocks. Break the perfect-circle feel subtly with occasional chunky protrusions, keep inner floor spacious for a gun and three crew. A few clearly readable LARGE khaki sandbags in 2 short groups along the rim, similar scale to style reference, rather than tiny repeated dots. Sparse large stones embedded in the floor, no dense photographic gravel. Some thick weathered wooden duckboard panels in connecting arms, clear planks with dark seams. No wood on cut edges at arm ends. Strong small-size readability, hand-painted bold clean contours. Strict 90-degree overhead orthographic, NO perspective or crater blast damage. Low earth walls around ALL bearings, no firing arc. Draw the complete pit shapes not just earth material swatches.
Transparent background, real alpha. NO grass, NO hex backgrounds or hex lines, NO text or labels, NO guns, infantry, crates, particles, shadows cast outside earthworks, UI or frames. Target 2160x2400 preserving exact atlas geometry.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production tile CONNECTOR STRIP for a WW2 top-down strategy game. Use the attached painted trench atlas as style reference only. Draw ONE straight horizontal infantry trench running continuously from the LEFT EDGE to the RIGHT EDGE of the image, centered vertically. A real excavated trench, not pipes or rails: irregular chunky warm ochre and tan EARTH CLODS form both upper and lower rim, a dark cut-earth inner wall and contact shadow under the clods, flat dark brown soil floor in the middle. Clear large hand-painted earth volumes, sparse medium stones on floor, no photographic gravel noise. The top and bottom earthen edges wander naturally but the trench stays straight overall. Floor band approximately y=208..304 on a 1024x512 canvas, the sculpted earth walls extend to y=130 and y=382, transparent outside. At both left and right image edges the floor and walls continue beyond canvas, no closed end caps. Same wall widths and richness as the reference atlas. Strong readability at small size. Strict 90-degree overhead orthographic. NO perspective. No wooden structural rails. NO wood, duckboards, sandbags, grass, soldiers, guns, text, grid, background or outer drop shadow. Just the continuous richly illustrated soil trench on real alpha transparency. Target 1024x512 landscape.
